technology_name: Molecular-Marker Based Coconut Hybrid Confirmation Technology
problem_solved: Need to confirm the hybrid nature of seedlings in the nursery itself to ensure supply of genuine hybrids to farmers.
description: Microsatellite markers developed at ICAR-CPCRI assist in screening the progenies from the crosses of parental palms to confirm their hybrid nature in the nursery itself. The use of these markers will ensure the supply of genuine hybrid seedlings to farmers.
applications: Commercial agricultural diagnostic screening, Quality control in plant nurseries, Manufacturing of agricultural genetic testing kits
